_about: Studies the editors want the blog agent to review on a given day (scripts/blog_agent/agent.py reads this). The agent still fetches and checks the primary source, skips anything already covered or not verifiable, and explains in the draft's notes. One entry per date and section. Delete entries once their day has passed.

entries.title: Artificial Intelligence-Enhanced Colposcopy Training Improves Diagnostic Reasoning and Communication Competencies
entries.source: Journal of Gynecology Obstetrics and Human Reproduction
entries.angle: AI virtual patients may speed up diagnostic reasoning and communication, but conversational coaching should not be assumed to transfer to procedural skill.
caveats: small, specialty-specific sample at affiliated sites
short follow-up and a wait-list design
no durable independent performance or patient outcomes

entries.title: Generative AI Factors, Cognitive Engagement, and Patient Safety Learning in Medical Education
entries.angle: Teaching responsible AI use should cover verification, calibrated trust, privacy, alignment with local protocols, and continued human accountability.
caveats: cross-sectional and self-reported, so no causal claim
a narrow sample of private universities in one country
